The affine map fixes each base and acts on its fiber by x↦Ax+Bz+c, multiplying every volume and M by |det A|. Hence the mixed probability measure is pushed forward exactly. Composing L with the inverse preserves positivity and its inverse-power normalization for the same r.
The projective energy scales by |det A| in the fiber interior and stays zero at mapped boundary marks, so the ratio LE/M is invariant there as well. The exponent 1/(d+1) is unchanged.

Each transformed centroid is Ag_z+Bz+c. The shear and translation cancel in X′−g′_z, and the mass-normalized covariance becomes AΣA^T. For u′=A^−Tu the covariance norm is preserved. Using α′=α−B^T u′ exactly cancels the extra drift u′·B(z−p); the correspondence is bijective and preserves the sign and magnitude of the displacement. This is an equality of normalized cap masses for fixed ε, including pure-base caps. A signed real ε obeys the same algebra if one elects to define shifted caps for it, with containment of the mark only automatic for the source's nonnegative buffer.
